title: Mosaic Interaction Endpoint PRD — calibrated rerank + deterministic embeddings
creator: Asha Patel
description: Deliver a single managed interaction endpoint that returns: (1) deterministic embeddings suitable for downstream vector stores and rerank, (2) a calibrated reranker score that maps to a stable probability band, and (3) compatibility with chat/completions payloads. This PRD covers behavioral contract, eval harness, rollout plan, and launch acceptance checklist for the hosted API lane. Goal: reduce customer integration friction for retrieval+rerank workflows and provide clear operational SLAs for quality and latency.
requirements: Deterministic embeddings: identical input -> identical embedding across minor model patch releases unless explicit version change is requested; provide a stable embedding_seed param for controlled nondeterminism
Embedding vector dimensionality and config must be surfaced in API metadata and preserved across versioned model variants
Rerank output: a calibrated score in [0,1] where scores map approximately to empirical click/quality likelihoods for common internal benchmark datasets
Endpoint supports combined payloads: text input + optional candidate list (for rerank) + retrieval context, with clear size limits and error behavior
Latency SLO (hosted): p95 end-to-end generation+rerank <= 220ms for small prompts (<=128 tokens) under single-request load profile
Throughput: can support 400 concurrent small requests per dedicated instance in the hosted lane; autoscaling hooks must enable burst to dedicated tenants
SDK ergonomic surface: one client call for interaction that returns generation, embedding, and rerank sections; streaming remains supported for generation but not for embeddings or rerank scores
Telemetry: token-level cost, model variant used, seed values, and rerank calibration version must be emitted in logs and included in Console dashboards
Backward compatibility: deprecated params must be clearly documented and trigger soft warnings in response headers for three releases before removal
scope_changes: Initial scoping included per-call quantized model selection; trimmed to recommend quantization profiles but defer automated quantized switching to next quarter
Added deterministic 'embedding_seed' param after security review recommended explicit seed control for reproducible evals
Dropped synchronous batch-rerank of >1k candidates from launch scope; support capped streaming candidate evaluation later
Expanded telemetry to include calibration version after early engineering spike revealed correlation drift during canary
acceptance_criteria: Embedding determinism test: 1000 random canonical inputs produce identical vectors across two separate deploys of the same model version
Embedding drift threshold: cosine similarity distribution shift between staging and production <= 0.02 (measured on eval corpus)
Rerank calibration: on internal retrieval benchmark, NDCG@10 improves over baseline reranker by >= 8% and predicted probability bands match empirical click rates within +/-5 percentage points
API contract: example payloads for chat, completions, embedding, and rerank validated by client SDK tests (pass in CI)
Latency: p95 generation+rerank <= 220ms for small prompts in throughput 1 tests and p95 <= 320ms under simulated 80% load profile
Operational: Console shows per-route telemetry (cost, p95 latency, quality delta) and alerting hooks are configured for regressions
Security: KMS usage for model metadata and audit logs enabled for private tenants; security_review_required flag set and issues resolved
Rollout: Canary at 5% for 48 hours with no quality regression alerts before 25% expansion; rollback triggers documented
launch_checklist: Finalize API contract and publish in API docs (examples for 4 common SDKs)
Merge SDK PRs and publish packages: python, js, go
End-to-end CI tests passing for chat+embedding+rerank flows
Deploy staging model variant and execute deterministic embedding validation suite
Run rerank calibration job and publish calibration metadata artifact to S3
Create Console dashboard: per-route cost, p95/p99 latency, rerank NDCG baseline, embedding drift histogram
Configure alerts: quality-regression (NDCG drop >5%), latency-regression (p95 > 300ms), cost-spike (>150% expected spend for 24h)
Prepare rollback playbook and add to runbook library; train on-call engineers
Customer beta cohort invite list and one-pager with known limits/behavioral caveats
Legal & Security signoff: data handling doc and KMS integration verification
Post-launch monitoring window scheduled (72 hours) with product + eng war room
Update changelog and migration guide describing embedding_seed and calibration_version fields
risks_mitigations: Risk: Embedding nondeterminism in downstream stores -> Mitigation: expose embedding_seed param and document best practices; provide tooling to reindex and compare old vs new vectors
Risk: Calibration drift after model updates -> Mitigation: include calibration_version in responses and automatic nightly sanity job that checks calibration metrics and creates regression PRs
Risk: Increased per-request latency when running rerank and generation serially -> Mitigation: benchmark parallel execution paths and provide an optional asynchronous rerank-only endpoint
Risk: Customers misuse combined endpoint for heavy candidate lists -> Mitigation: enforce conservative hard limits at API layer and return actionable 413 errors with guidance
